thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PAGER: GPU capacity exhaustion detected in projects/redwood-prod-us-west4 at 14:02 UTC — autoscaler failing to provision additional nodes (scale attempts: 12, failures: 12). Paging oncall-sam.
oncall-sam: ack -- picking this up. putting my phone on loud. :phone: anyone seeing customer-facing errors?
elena: seeing queue backlog rising on inference-route /v1/generate in us-west4, latency spikes ~3x. Some 503s to customers who pinned to that region.
rahul: confirmed. Metrics: pending-pod-requests = 860, pending-replicas = 120, recent autoscaler logs show quota errors from GCP API: "INSUFFICIENT_QUOTA: 'GPUS_PER_REGION'".
oncall-sam: pinging infra-bot for current quota state and any ongoing quota change requests.
infra-bot: Current GCP quota for A100 (us-west4) = 64 (project limit), in-use = 64. Preemptible pool requests blocked. No pending quota increase; last request 3 days ago (case: gcp-9421) still in review.
oncall-sam: OK. Immediate mitigations: 1) reroute traffic away from us-west4 to us-west1/us-central1 if compatible; 2) demote low-priority jobs and scale down batched offline jobs; 3) attempt ephemeral remove of region affinity for multi-region customers.
maya: starting traffic reroute: updating route table to prefer us-central1 for non-pinned sessions. Will push a quick flag to the traffic-router service.
elena: adding quick guardrail -- reject new pinned sessions in us-west4 with 429 + Retry-After header. Patch rolling now.
rahul: trying manual scale attempt to non-preemptible GPUs (different quota). Running: 
```
# try creating 4 nodes in us-west4 with 1 GPU each
gcloud compute instances create rwd-grid-temp-1 --zone=us-west4-a --maintenance-policy=TERMINATE --accelerator=type=nvidia-a100,count=1 --machine-type=n1-standard-16
```
rahul: got API error: "quotaExceeded: Quota 'GPUS' exceeded for region us-west4".
oncall-sam: copy. Good to know non-preemptible also hit.
maya: traffic-router patch deployed. Non-pinned traffic is trickling to us-central1 now, latency returning to normal there.
elena: customer impact list so we can triage outreach: 1) acme-ml (pinned to us-west4) experiencing failed requests; 2) partner-x (region affinity) degraded; 3) several small customers on free-tier facing 429s.
oncall-sam: assigning customer-comms: @maya to draft short status message and ETA. Rahul, can you open an expedited quota support case with GCP (billing escalation + partner line)? We need quota increase or temporary project-level lift.
rahul: opening now. Case: SR-559331 (escalation via TAM). Pushing for 200 additional A100 quota in us-west4 for 24h.
infra-bot: Noted. Also detected another project in our org using 8 GPUs in us-west4 (internal batch jobs). Suggest suspending their batch jobs.
oncall-sam: @rahul can you identify which internal workloads we can pause?
rahul: found: project redwood-internal-batch -> job: nightly-evals uses 8 A100s. Pausing now via orchestration: 
```
kubectl -n batch scale deploy nightly-evals --replicas=0 --context=prod-us-west4
```
rahul: paused. Freed 8 GPUs, but still not enough. Pending-pod-requests down from 860 -> 820.
maya: enabling burst fallback: route small inference traffic to hosted-optimizer cluster in us-west1 (no GPU but CPU-quantized path) for short responses. Might degrade quality for some prompts. Communicating in status.
elena: I'm compiling a short root-cause summary: autoscaler attempted to increase node pool, GCP returned region GPU quota exhausted. Two contributing factors: recent on-prem migration increased demand in us-west4 + delayed quota propagation for previous quota request.
oncall-sam: Good. Next actions: 1) keep reroute in place until quota increase confirmed; 2) run customers impacted list and owners; 3) prepare rollback plan if reroute causes regressions.
rahul: update from GCP support: SR-559331 -> assigned to TAM, target response 45 minutes. They flagged organization-level quotas also near limits.
oncall-sam: request internal management for temporary burst capacity: can we spin up additional capacity in partner-dedicated cluster? @elena?
elena: partner-dedicated cluster has reserved capacity for partner agreements. I can request to borrow up to 10 GPUs for 6 hours. Approving will require notifying partner ops.
oncall-sam: approve borrowing 10 GPUs now. Please coordinate.
elena: done. Spinning up nodes in partner cluster and adding to inference pool. That freed 10 GPUs; pending-pod-requests dropped to 680.
maya: customer comm drafted: "We are experiencing degraded performance in us-west4 due to GPU capacity constraints. Non-pinned traffic has been rerouted. Teams are working on increasing capacity and will provide updates every 30 minutes." Posting to status.redwood.ai and notifying top 5 customers.
oncall-sam: reaction :thumbsup:. Also: enable autoscaler debug logs and dump last 200 lines to #eng-runtime for postmortem. Command: 
```
kubectl -n infra logs hpa-controller-0 --tail=200 --context=prod-us-west4
```
rahul: logs show repeated GCP 403/429-like quota errors with backoff. Suggest adding exponential backoff jitter and fallback to alternate regions earlier in autoscaler logic. Filing a follow-up ticket.
elena: noted. We'll also add a health signal to traffic-router to avoid routing to regions with known quota exhaustion.
oncall-sam: timeline so far: 14:02 pager -> 14:06 reroute & pin-block -> 14:14 paused internal batch -> 14:22 partner-cluster borrow -> 14:30 traffic mostly stable, pending queue reduced but still above SLO.
infra-bot: GCP update: temporary quota increase approved for 100 GPUs in us-west4 for 2 hours (case SR-559331 updated). Propagation ETA 4 minutes.
rahul: seeing IAM quota propagate now, starting node creation. New nodes coming up.
oncall-sam: great. Keep monitoring for noisy neighbor behavior. Once traffic normalized, plan: 1) postmortem + RCA; 2) runbook edits: autoscaler fallback earlier, per-org quota dashboards, automated suspend for batch jobs when region pressure high; 3) request long-term quota increases where justified.
maya: posting initial incident summary to #incidents and tagging ops leads. Will coordinate customer follow-ups.
elena: adding a quick ops checklist entry: 
- verify quotas per-region daily
- create alert when pending-pod-requests > 200 for 10m
- add safety throttle for pinned sessions

oncall-sam: handing off to eng-runtime for mitigation work. I'm staying on this thread until stable. If anything new, @rahul/@elena/@maya please ping.
incident-bot: Incident acknowledged closed by oncall-sam at 15:12 UTC (status: mitigated).
